name: Email Sender (SMTP)
description: Send emails using SMTP protocol with support for authentication, HTML content, and attachments

smtpHost.label: SMTP Host
smtpHost.description: The hostname or IP address of the SMTP server (e.g., smtp.example.com)

smtpPort.label: SMTP Port
smtpPort.description: The port number of the SMTP server (e.g., 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL)

smtpUsername.label: SMTP Username
smtpUsername.description: The username for SMTP authentication (often your email address)

smtpPassword.label: SMTP Password
smtpPassword.description: The password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication

useTLS.label: Use TLS
useTLS.description: Whether to use TLS encryption for the SMTP connection

toEmails.label: To Emails
toEmails.description: Comma-separated list of recipient email addresses

ccEmails.label: CC Emails
ccEmails.description: Comma-separated list of CC recipient email addresses

bccEmails.label: BCC Emails
bccEmails.description: Comma-separated list of BCC recipient email addresses

body.label: Body
body.description: The body content of the email (supports HTML if isHtml is true)

isHtml.label: Is HTML
isHtml.description: Whether the email body is HTML formatted

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.description: Comma-separated list of file paths to attach to the email

replyTo.label: Reply To
replyTo.description: The email address to use for the Reply-To header

success.label: Success
success.description: Indicates whether the email was sent successfully

error.label: Error
error.description: Error message if the email failed to send

messageId.label: Message ID
messageId.description: The message ID assigned by the SMTP server

acceptedRecipients.label: Accepted Recipients
acceptedRecipients.description: List of recipients that were accepted by the SMTP server

rejectedRecipients.label: Rejected Recipients
rejectedRecipients.description: List of recipients that were rejected by the SMTP server
